content.title: Chapter 14 - ANIMALS — Sec. 14-42. - Dog license required.
content.summary:

faqs.a:
(a)
A license is required for any dog over the age of four months, within 30 days of acquisition
               of said dog, or within 30 days of the owner moving into the city, whichever occurs
               last. It shall be unlawful for the owner of any such dog to fail to obtain such license.
(b)
Application for such license shall be made to the Foothills Animal Shelter or such
               agents as designated by the Foothills Animal Shelter. The Foothills Animal Shelter
               or such agents as designated by the City of Arvada will administer the City of Arvada's
               dog licensing program and issue dog licenses.
(c)
To obtain a dog license, a dog owner must submit proof of a current rabies vaccination
               administered by a Colorado licensed veterinarian within 365 days prior to licensing,
               or in the case of a booster vaccination, within the time period recommended by the
               animal compendium of animal rabies control.
(d)
The dog owner must renew the dog license once every 365 days.
(e)
License fees, including fees for renewal licenses, shall be set by the Foothills Animal
               Shelter Board of Directors. Fees shall be reduced for spayed or neutered dogs. Proof
               of spaying or neutering by a licensed veterinarian is required for a dog to qualify
               for the reduced license fee.
(1)
A dog owner may request a reduced license fee if, for medical reasons, a dog cannot
               be vaccinated or spayed or neutered. Any dog owner making such a request must submit
               to the Foothills Animal Shelter or such agents as designated by the Foothills Animal
               Shelter an affidavit signed by a licensed veterinarian stating why the dog is unable
               to be vaccinated or spayed or neutered.
(2)
An assistance dog must be licensed as set forth herein. A person with a disability
               is exempt from any licensing fees that might otherwise apply as set forth in C.R.S.
               § 24-34-803.
(f)
License fees shall be used for operational expenses of the Foothills Animal Shelter.
(g)
Any dog owner or entity exempt from Jefferson County's dog licensing requirements
               shall be exempt from the provisions of this
section 14-42
.
(
Ord. No. 4060, § 2, 3-19-2007
;
Ord. No. 4399, § 2, 8-5-2013
)
